title: Credit Desk Ruling: Buying Rates on the Season Volume Discount, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Where a member's crop input account shows a season's steady buying behind it, the volume discount rate on that account is set from the deliveries invoiced to it and from the credit department's standing decision on the account rather than from the rate the programme carries.

**The ruling.** Where eight or more deliveries were invoiced to the account over the 14 statement months before the handling date and the credit department's standing decision on the account is an approval, the volume discount rate is 2.25 percent. Where eight or more deliveries were invoiced to the account over those months and that decision is conditional, the volume discount rate is 1.90 percent. In every other case no buying rate is substituted on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

## Both sides of the count and both decisions

| Deliveries invoiced over the 14 statement months | Standing decision on the account | Volume discount rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8 or more | approval | 2.25 percent |
| 8 or more | conditional | 1.90 percent |
| 7 or fewer | approval | No buying rate is substituted |
| 7 or fewer | conditional | No buying rate is substituted |

The count is a count of deliveries invoiced to that account inside the window: a seventh delivery leaves the account short of the eight the ruling turns on, and an eighth reaches it. The decision the ruling reads is the decision standing on the account, not a decision the member reports.
